dependency_constraints.source: Issue #11462 Environment section lists numpy 2.4.6, as reported by the reporter; no constraint is stated for the revision

numerical_failure.observed_behavior: xr.polyval returns a large negative sentinel value (-1.84467441e+19) at the position where the timedelta64 input is NaT, instead of a missing value. The other entries are finite: 1.0 and 345601.0.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The NaT position should propagate as NaN, giving [1.0, nan, 345601.0].
trigger_conditions: input array has dtype timedelta64 (reproducer uses timedelta64[D])
the timedelta array contains NaT entries
the timedelta array is passed as the coordinate or offset argument to xr.polyval
NaT is stored as the int64 minimum, so a plain astype(float) cast turns it into a large sentinel

input_output_examples.input: offset = xr.DataArray(np.array([0, "NaT", 2], dtype="timedelta64[D]"), dims="offset"); coefficients = xr.DataArray([2.0, 1.0], dims="degree", coords={"degree": [1, 0]}); result = xr.polyval(offset, coefficients)

oracle_clues: Expected output stated as [1.0, nan, 345601.0]; the NaT position should be NaN
PR #11478 adds test_polyval_timedelta_nat, which fails on main and passes with the fix
Fix masks NaT positions back to NaN after the float cast via .where(x.notnull()) in the to_floatable

numerical_characteristics.magnitude: NaT stored as int64 minimum cast to float yields about -1.84e19 sentinel (e.g. -1.84467441e+19); valid values such as 345601.0 keep their existing numeric scale
category_specific_evidence: Issue #11462 reproducer: xr.polyval on timedelta64[D] offset [0, NaT, 2] with coefficients [2.0, 1.0] at degree [1, 0] returns [1.0, -1.84467441e+19, 345601.0]; expected [1.0, nan, 345601.0]
PR #11478 states _ensure_numeric (used by polyval and polyfit) converts timedelta64 via plain astype(float), and NaT stored as int64 minimum becomes a large sentinel rather than a missing value
Fix in xarray/computation/computation.py to_floatable: astype(float) followed by .where(x.notnull()) so NaT positions become NaN, mirroring the datetime_to_numeric path
Added test test_polyval_timedelta_nat asserting actual.values[1] is NaN and valid positions [0,2] are not NaN; PR reports it fails on main and passes with the fix
Issue notes regression introduced by PR #6599
reproduction_risks: Special value involved is NaT (not-a-time) rather than IEEE NaN, inf, signed zero or subnormal; the passages do not discuss inf, signed zero or subnormals
Sentinel output depends on the int64-minimum cast behaviour, which the passages attribute to plain astype(float) on this numpy/xarray version (issue environment lists xarray 2026.7.0, numpy 2.4.6)
Passages do not state the exact tolerance used by the test; the test uses np.isnan checks rather than a numeric tolerance
